findings.highlight: the taste is coarse, but I can also feel a great deal of care
findings.evidenceJa: 味付けも粗雑でありながら、きめ細かい気配りが感じられる
findings.governingReading: Saber finds the seasoning rough or rustic while also sensing fine-grained care in it.
findings.explanation: The English calls the taste itself coarse and weakens the deliberate contrast between rough seasoning and meticulous consideration.

findings.highlight: If I stop eating from now on
findings.evidenceJa: 彼に、今から食事を断たれてしまったら
findings.governingReading: Saber imagines Shirou cutting off her meals from now on, which would sap her will to fight.
findings.explanation: The English makes Saber choose to stop eating, reversing the actor and breaking the mock siege logic of dependence on Shirou’s provisions.

findings.governingReading: Saber judges herself still naive, soft, or insufficiently prepared in the face of this imagined provisioning threat.
findings.explanation: Indulgent suggests permissiveness or self-pampering and disconnects her martial self-rebuke from the starvation-tactics joke.
